reference_sql:
SELECT store_code,
       SUM(units) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS units_per_line
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY store_code
ORDER BY units_per_line DESC, store_code
LIMIT 2
alternatives: SELECT store_code, CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS units_per_line FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_code ORDER BY CAST(SUM(units) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) DESC, store_code ASC LIMIT 2
